sourceCoverage.chapterCharacter: Huihui (Islamic) calendar ready-reckoner construction treatise, part 2: solar, five-planet, apogee and lunar mean-motion tables and the weekday (seven-luminaries) tables. No individual is named, quoted or acted upon; 洪武甲子 and 隋己未 are calendrical epochs, not people.
sourceCoverage.readMethod: Every unit's Chinese, literal and idiomatic field read in full in bounded portions (s0001-s0050, s0051-s0100, s0101-s0145).
mechanicalChecks: 344 multi-character Chinese numerals checked against both English fields; every residual was inspected by hand.

Every unit aligned against the Siku Quanshu Wenyuange text of 明史 卷38 (Kanripo KR2a0038 commit eccd6fe93126bde61b837240e6142e1343c22639, file sha256 8f2e7ed1786612a7d6399bb0d5cdcffbe1944c1e63eb6e6db7544c9ccbf35ff3) after variant-character normalization; every value-bearing difference was checked against internal parallels and the tables' own arithmetic before any repair was proposed.

substantiveFindings.summary: The received chapter text has many scrape corruptions. Earlier work repaired seven of them; the owner pass found 17 more units where the English states a value or term that the received text does not support, or that the Siku edition, internal parallels and the tables' arithmetic show to be wrong. Among them are one invented numeral (s0059: '1°' where the Chinese has no degree numeral), an impossible longitude (s0058: 34° in a 30° sign), a lost epoch (s0066: 'year 140' for 1,440), two eye-skip omissions that misattribute values (s0023 solar total-year; s0130 epicycle/Rahu), a mistranslated corruption (s0004: 交多不祿 for 文多不録, 'conjunctions mostly not recorded'), and 本輪 rendered as 'deferent' in four idiomatic uses although 13°04′/day is lunar epicyclic anomaly.

Applying any English repair changes the extraction chapterFingerprint/unitDigests and the date-audit sourceHash (which hashes zh, en and literal). The date audit then becomes stale under dateAuditStatus even though it has zero items and zero people.
substantiveFindings.resolution: Host re-fingerprints the extraction with the production applier (appending these repairs as applied translationRepairs) and the final independent reviewer re-records the zero-item date audit against the amended chapter. Do not copy the old report or change its hashes.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 每立成內，首列本信立成處月日宮各紀數，次刑七曜，次刑日中心行度，及土、木、火、金、水各自行度日五星最高行度，交多不祿。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Within each ready reckoner, first list the tallies for month, day, and sign at that ready reckoner's principal entries; next list the seven luminaries; next list the Sun's center-travel degree and Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury each self-travel degree and the five planets' greatest-high travel degrees; conjunctions mostly not recorded.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Within each ready reckoner, first list the tallies of year, month, day, and sign for that ready reckoner; next list the seven luminaries; next list the Sun's center-travel degree and Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury each self-travel degree and the Sun's and five planets' greatest-high travel degrees; the text is lengthy and is not recorded here.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: The received 本信立成處…次刑…交多不祿 is corrupt: the Siku text reads 首列本立成年月日宮各紀數，次列七曜…日五星最高行度，文多不録 ("the text is lengthy and not recorded"), which is what introduces s0005 録其造立成之法於左. "Conjunctions/conjunction data are mostly omitted" translates the corrupt 交 (for 文) and 祿 (for 録); the tallies are of year, month, day and sign; 日五星最高行度 includes the Sun's apogee.

definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Approximate method: each year subtract 11 degrees 4 parts 51 seconds; intercalary year subtract 10 degrees 5 parts 43 seconds; thirty years make one sign 8 degrees 25 parts 31 seconds.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 第一年爲三宮二十六度五分十九秒。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: First year is three signs 26 degrees 5 parts 19 seconds.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: First year is three signs 26 degrees 5 parts 8 seconds. [The received text omits the following, supplied from the Siku edition: This is the root number fixed at the Sui jìwèi observation; one says it is the Hongwu jiazi year number, with the additive tier already calculated in. Six hundred years: five signs 14 degrees 25 parts 19 seconds.]
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: The received unit has lost a clause by eye-skip from the 五分 of 五分八秒 to the 五分 of 二十五分十九秒: the Siku text reads 第一年為三宫二十六度五分八秒此隋己未測定根數一雲即洪武甲子年數已算加次在内六百年五宫十四度二十五分十九秒. The received 十九秒 is the tail of the lost 600-year value, so "26°05′19″" misstates the year-1 value (08″) and the 600-year entry and root-number note that every parallel planet table carries (s0040/s0042) are missing. The Chinese unit is left unchanged; the supplied clause is bracketed and attributed to the Siku edition.
